name: Age Verification & Identity Verification by Token of Trust
author: Token of Trust

sections.description:
Age Verification and Identity Verification for WordPress and WooCommerce

Token of Trust helps WordPress and WooCommerce businesses verify customer age and identity using identity-backed verification.

Add age verification to WooCommerce checkout, verify customers using government-issued ID, and configure when verification is required for age-restricted products and customer journeys.

Built for businesses selling vape, tobacco, nicotine, alcohol, and other age-restricted products, with identity verification and KYC capabilities for businesses that need to verify more than age.

Start using Token of Trust for free. No credit card required.

Get free verifications when you create your Token of Trust account. Set up your WordPress or WooCommerce integration, run live verifications, and explore Token of Trust’s verification features at your own pace.

Keep track of your remaining free verifications in your account. When you need more, choose a paid plan to keep verifying.

More Than an Age Gate

A basic age gate asks visitors to confirm their age by clicking a button or entering a birth date.

Token of Trust helps businesses verify age using identity-backed verification when greater assurance is needed. Depending on the verification workflow, Token of Trust can use customer information and identity verification methods to help determine whether a customer meets the required age threshold.

That makes Token of Trust a fit for WooCommerce businesses selling age-restricted products that need more than a simple 18+ or 21+ popup.

Add age verification to your customer journey, configure when verification is required, and access additional identity verification capabilities when your business needs them.

Who Is Token of Trust For?

Token of Trust is designed for WordPress and WooCommerce businesses that need to verify customer age, identity, or both.

Common use cases include:

  • Vape, tobacco, and nicotine ecommerce
  • Alcohol ecommerce and other age-restricted products
  • Adult and age-restricted content
  • Customer identity verification
  • KYC and higher-assurance verification workflows

How Token of Trust Works With WordPress and WooCommerce

Getting started is straightforward:

  1. Install and activate the Token of Trust plugin.
  2. Create or connect your Token of Trust account. New accounts receive a free verification quota that can be used to test your verification workflow.
  3. Configure your verification requirements.
  4. Add age or identity verification to the appropriate customer journey.
  5. Customers complete verification when required.
  6. Review verification results through your Token of Trust and WooCommerce workflow.

Verification can be triggered during WooCommerce checkout, for selected products using product categories or tags, or for specific WordPress pages.

Previously verified customers can securely reuse an existing verification by confirming access to the email address associated with that verification.

Age Verification Features

Token of Trust gives WordPress and WooCommerce businesses flexible control over how and when customers are verified.

  • Identity-backed age verification using government-issued ID
  • Flexible verification rules based on minimum age, customer location, and selected WooCommerce products
  • WooCommerce checkout verification with verification status available on customer orders
  • Reusable verification that lets eligible returning customers securely confirm and reuse a previous verification
  • On-demand verification for WooCommerce orders that require an additional check
  • Optional Age Gate for self-declared age confirmation before visitors access your site

Identity Verification and KYC

Token of Trust can also support businesses that need to verify more than age.

  • Identity verification using government-issued ID and customer information
  • KYC workflows for businesses that need to verify customer identity as part of onboarding
  • Identity validation to evaluate customer information against verification requirements
  • Higher-assurance workflows when additional identity verification is required

This gives businesses access to broader identity assurance capabilities when their requirements go beyond age verification.

Start With Free Verifications

See how Token of Trust works on your WordPress or WooCommerce site with 25 free verifications.

No credit card required. Set up your verification workflow, run live age and identity verifications, and test your integration today.

Keep track of your remaining free verifications right from your account. When you’re ready for more, choose a plan that fits your verification needs.

Privacy-Focused Verification

Verification often involves sensitive customer information.

Token of Trust is designed to help businesses verify customer eligibility and identity while limiting unnecessary friction and supporting privacy-conscious verification workflows.

Instead of treating every visitor the same, businesses can configure verification experiences appropriate to their use case and customer journey.

Need Help?

Have questions about setting up age verification or identity verification with Token of Trust? Contact us and our team can help.

Using Token of Trust With Member Management Plugins

Token of Trust works alongside member management systems that set up user profiles, membership tiers, and custom pages in WordPress. Common plugins include:

  • BuddyPress
  • Ultimate Member

Other Integrations

Discover Token of Trust’s WordPress Integration Options for details on advanced scenarios and additional plugin compatibility.

Languages

Token of Trust has been translated into:

  • English (US)
  • Spanish
  • French
  • Additional languages available upon request
sections.installation:
From Your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Visit “Plugins” > “Add New”
  2. Search for “Token of Trust”
  3. Install and activate the Token of Trust plugin
  4. Follow the “Get Started” setup process in WordPress
  5. Complete the Token of Trust signup process when prompted
  6. Return to WordPress and click “Connect” to complete the integration
  7. Configure your age or identity verification rules

Your API keys and license are automatically generated and connected during setup, so you do not need to manually copy and enter them.

From WordPress.org or GitHub

  1. Upload the Token of Trust plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the Token of Trust plugin
  3. Follow the “Get Started” setup process in WordPress
  4. Complete the Token of Trust signup process when prompted
  5. Return to WordPress and click “Connect” to complete the integration
  6. Configure your age or identity verification rules

If the automatic connection does not complete successfully, you can manually connect your Production Domain and API keys from the Token of Trust settings.

For additional documentation, visit our WordPress Plugin Docs.

Widget Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes to embed age verification and identity verification in pages or posts. They default to the currently logged-in user:

Account Connector

Allows a logged-in user to connect their WordPress profile to Token of Trust to begin age verification or identity verification. For security, only display this widget on protected pages for the intended user.

[tot-wp-embed tot-widget="accountConnector"][/tot-wp-embed]

To show the account connector using to the person API.

[tot-wp-embed tot-widget="accountConnector" verification-model="person"][/tot-wp-embed]

Reputation Summary

Shows a brief overview of the user’s verification status (age, identity, or both).

[tot-wp-embed tot-widget="reputationSummary"][/tot-wp-embed]

Profile Photo

Displays the user’s chosen Token of Trust photo.

[tot-wp-embed tot-widget="profilePhoto"][/tot-wp-embed]

Verified Indicator

Shows a small icon reflecting how far a user has progressed in age/identity verification.

[tot-wp-embed tot-widget="verifiedIndicator"][/tot-wp-embed]

To display the icon even when the user is not verified:

[tot-wp-embed tot-widget="verifiedIndicator" tot-show-when-not-verified="true"][/tot-wp-embed]

Additional Settings

Override user or widget-specific attributes, for example:

[tot-wp-embed wp-userid="EXAMPLE" tot-widget="reputationSummary"][/tot-wp-embed]

Render in Templates/PHP

Use WordPress shortcodes in your PHP templates:

<?php

echo do_shortcode('[tot-wp-embed tot-widget="reputationSummary"][/tot-wp-embed]');
sections.faq:
Is Token of Trust free to try?

Yes. New Token of Trust accounts receive a limited number of free verifications upfront. No credit card is required to get started.

Instead of a time-limited trial, your account uses a free verification quota. You can configure your integration and use your available free verifications until the quota is exhausted. Your account tracks usage so you can see how many free verifications remain.

What happens when I use my free verification quota?

Your account tracks each verification against your available free quota and displays an alert showing how many free verifications remain.

Once your free verification quota is exhausted, you can add a payment method or upgrade your account to continue running additional verifications.

What is the difference between an age gate and age verification?

An age gate typically asks a visitor to self-declare their age, such as clicking “I am 21+” or entering a date of birth.

Age verification provides additional assurance by using verification methods to evaluate whether a customer meets the required age threshold.

Token of Trust supports identity-backed age verification for businesses that need greater assurance than self-declaration.

Can I require age verification only for certain WooCommerce products?

Yes. You can require age verification for selected products using WooCommerce product categories or tags. If an order contains a product that matches a configured category or tag, age verification is triggered at checkout.

To limit verification to selected categories or tags, set the minimum order amount above zero. Otherwise, verification will apply to all orders.

Can customers reuse their verification?

Yes. Eligible returning customers can securely reuse a previous verification by confirming access to the email address associated with that verification.

This can help reduce unnecessary repeat verification for returning customers.

Does Token of Trust support identity verification and KYC?

Yes. Token of Trust supports identity verification using government-issued IDs and selfie matching, with capabilities that can support KYC workflows.

Businesses can use identity verification during customer onboarding, checkout, or other workflows where identity assurance is required.

Does installing Token of Trust make my business compliant?

No software by itself can determine or guarantee a business’s compliance with every applicable law or regulation.

Token of Trust provides age and identity verification capabilities designed to help businesses implement their verification and compliance workflows. Businesses should determine their specific legal and regulatory obligations with appropriate advisors.

Can I run Token of Trust on a local testing environment?

Yes. We support various localhost ports, including 80, 443, 3000, 3001, 3443, 7888, 8000, 8080, 8888, 32080, 32443, or 33080. The plugin identifies when you’re on localhost and automatically adapts.

How do I request a Data Processing Addendum (DPA)?

Request our Data Processing Addendum (DPA) by emailing support@tokenoftrust.com.

short_description: Verify customer age and identity using government-issued ID. Works at WooCommerce checkout, on selected products, or on any WordPress page.
description:
Age Verification and Identity Verification for WordPress and WooCommerce

Token of Trust helps WordPress and WooCommerce businesses verify customer age and identity using identity-backed verification.

Add age verification to WooCommerce checkout, verify customers using government-issued ID, and configure when verification is required for age-restricted products and customer journeys.

Built for businesses selling vape, tobacco, nicotine, alcohol, and other age-restricted products, with identity verification and KYC capabilities for businesses that need to verify more than age.

Start using Token of Trust for free. No credit card required.

Get free verifications when you create your Token of Trust account. Set up your WordPress or WooCommerce integration, run live verifications, and explore Token of Trust’s verification features at your own pace.

Keep track of your remaining free verifications in your account. When you need more, choose a paid plan to keep verifying.

More Than an Age Gate

A basic age gate asks visitors to confirm their age by clicking a button or entering a birth date.

Token of Trust helps businesses verify age using identity-backed verification when greater assurance is needed. Depending on the verification workflow, Token of Trust can use customer information and identity verification methods to help determine whether a customer meets the required age threshold.

That makes Token of Trust a fit for WooCommerce businesses selling age-restricted products that need more than a simple 18+ or 21+ popup.

Add age verification to your customer journey, configure when verification is required, and access additional identity verification capabilities when your business needs them.

Who Is Token of Trust For?

Token of Trust is designed for WordPress and WooCommerce businesses that need to verify customer age, identity, or both.

Common use cases include:

  • Vape, tobacco, and nicotine ecommerce
  • Alcohol ecommerce and other age-restricted products
  • Adult and age-restricted content
  • Customer identity verification
  • KYC and higher-assurance verification workflows

How Token of Trust Works With WordPress and WooCommerce

Getting started is straightforward:

  1. Install and activate the Token of Trust plugin.
  2. Create or connect your Token of Trust account. New accounts receive a free verification quota that can be used to test your verification workflow.
  3. Configure your verification requirements.
  4. Add age or identity verification to the appropriate customer journey.
  5. Customers complete verification when required.
  6. Review verification results through your Token of Trust and WooCommerce workflow.

Verification can be triggered during WooCommerce checkout, for selected products using product categories or tags, or for specific WordPress pages.

Previously verified customers can securely reuse an existing verification by confirming access to the email address associated with that verification.

Age Verification Features

Token of Trust gives WordPress and WooCommerce businesses flexible control over how and when customers are verified.

  • Identity-backed age verification using government-issued ID
  • Flexible verification rules based on minimum age, customer location, and selected WooCommerce products
  • WooCommerce checkout verification with verification status available on customer orders
  • Reusable verification that lets eligible returning customers securely confirm and reuse a previous verification
  • On-demand verification for WooCommerce orders that require an additional check
  • Optional Age Gate for self-declared age confirmation before visitors access your site

Identity Verification and KYC

Token of Trust can also support businesses that need to verify more than age.

  • Identity verification using government-issued ID and customer information
  • KYC workflows for businesses that need to verify customer identity as part of onboarding
  • Identity validation to evaluate customer information against verification requirements
  • Higher-assurance workflows when additional identity verification is required

This gives businesses access to broader identity assurance capabilities when their requirements go beyond age verification.

Start With Free Verifications

See how Token of Trust works on your WordPress or WooCommerce site with 25 free verifications.

No credit card required. Set up your verification workflow, run live age and identity verifications, and test your integration today.

Keep track of your remaining free verifications right from your account. When you’re ready for more, choose a plan that fits your verification needs.

Privacy-Focused Verification

Verification often involves sensitive customer information.

Token of Trust is designed to help businesses verify customer eligibility and identity while limiting unnecessary friction and supporting privacy-conscious verification workflows.

Instead of treating every visitor the same, businesses can configure verification experiences appropriate to their use case and customer journey.

Need Help?

Have questions about setting up age verification or identity verification with Token of Trust? Contact us and our team can help.

Using Token of Trust With Member Management Plugins

Token of Trust works alongside member management systems that set up user profiles, membership tiers, and custom pages in WordPress. Common plugins include:

  • BuddyPress
  • Ultimate Member

Other Integrations

Discover Token of Trust’s WordPress Integration Options for details on advanced scenarios and additional plugin compatibility.

Languages

Token of Trust has been translated into:

  • English (US)
  • Spanish
  • French
  • Additional languages available upon request
